label: input p/q/g/3 in the middle-late original phase (context-gated)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, never at t<2, the delimiter, or the copy phase. Peaks at positions 4-6. Driven by the current input token: p is strongest (12x lift, 46% of mass, and holds all the top activations), then q, g and digit 3. Weak spillover on 2, s, t and i. Mostly on first occurrences of the token. It is strongly context-gated: only about 12% of p inputs fire. Firing is more likely when earlier inputs include e, f, r, n or o; first_tok e has 4.3x lift. Adding seen([e,f,r,n,o]) raises dev precision from 0.23 to 0.32 but cuts mass recall to 0.77. The predicate captures about 91% of activation mass with low precision (about 0.23), so the gating context is not fully captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: p, q, g, 3, 2, s; least: k, c, j, n) and the first original token (most: e, f, r, n, o, c; least: 2, q, g, p); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=4, t=6.
